records.title: Type-0 FLR endpoint is technically attachable only with a complete domain
records.blocker: Portable components now replay caller-supplied 256-byte PCI config, bind Type-0/FLR facts into DeviceRecord V3, HostSnapshot semantics, closure and the guarded hardware gate, and separately verify a COMMITTED rollback anchor. They remain productAuthorized=false: the target Qman collector, retained provider capture, reset provider, direct authority fetch/CAS, external anchor adapter and capability publisher still do not emit one authoritative complete-domain decision.

records.title: Type-1 bridge is rejected as a VM payload even when FLR is present
records.blocker: The component V3 verifier rejects a replayed Type-1/PCIe fabric function as payload even when its raw FLR bit is present, but the production Qman role gate, collector and publisher are not mapped and do not yet prove the same exclusion while retaining bridge dependencies in closure.

records.title: Class code does not override the Type-0 role conclusion
records.blocker: Component A/B tests keep class code and Header Type orthogonal and derive layout only from offset 0x0e, but the target Qman collector/publication/capability path lacks an end-to-end product-mapped A/B receipt.

records.title: Root-complex endpoint without a safe reset contract is rejected
records.blocker: The component replays PCIe Device Capabilities bit 28 and rejects selected PCI_FLR when absent, but the authoritative product reset provider, alternate-reset qualification and pre-attach denial path are not implemented or mapped.

records.title: Bridge reset affected set is leased as one indivisible bundle
records.blocker: VFIO hot-reset discovery, affected-set re-query and bundle lease integration are not connected to the product controller.

records.title: No-ACS strict and conditional profiles preserve physical isolation
records.blocker: The product has no authoritative physical-domain evaluator and no supported-profile gate distinguishing strict rejection from a qualified conditional mode.

records.title: ACS override never shrinks the physical isolation domain
records.blocker: The kernel-native shadow-domain ABI and runtime override-on/off product evidence are not implemented; the existing build is only a premise.

records.title: Requester-ID aliases and legacy subtrees are allocated together
records.blocker: Requester-ID alias discovery and conservative legacy-subtree closure are not available from an authoritative product inventory source.

records.title: Narrow errata denial uses exact identity and revision
records.blocker: The signed compatibility catalog, exact revision matcher and stable product reason code are not implemented.

records.title: Unhealthy or quarantined devices never enter the candidate pool
records.blocker: Health ingestion, durable quarantine state and candidate-pool exclusion are not wired into the product capability publisher.

records.title: Sub-page BARs require exclusive host-page ownership
records.blocker: The host resource-page provenance collector and shared-page fail-closed admission rule are not implemented in the product path.

records.title: RCiEP regular-function and VF behavior is qualified on supported hardware
records.blocker: Final RCiEP regular-function versus VF reset and isolation behavior requires a supported physical RCiEP/VF platform; synthetic topology cannot establish the hardware result.

records.title: SR-IOV PF, VF and reset dependencies form one qualified closure
records.blocker: PF/VF lifecycle discovery, ARI-aware dependency closure and per-member reset qualification are not implemented in the product provider.

records.title: Guest PF cannot mutate host-managed SR-IOV VF lifecycle
records.blocker: The product QEMU profile and bypass gate do not yet filter or deny guest writes to VF Enable and NumVFs.

records.title: VFIO cdev, legacy and mixed hot-reset ownership modes fail closed
records.blocker: The selected product backend lacks authoritative ownership-mode discovery, mixed-mode rejection and execution-time affected-set verification.

records.title: Kernel-native shadow domain is equal to or more conservative than stock isolation
records.blocker: The native shadow-domain ABI, per-component unknown handling and override-off/on differential runner are not available in a production kernel profile.
